content: {"phoneNote":"The receipt motif is a nice trade-specific touch, but the hero repeats the fixed bar's call action with two plain text links and the receipt's service list is duplicated by the 'Naše storitve' section further down.","desktopNote":"The hero column leaves a large empty band under the text links while the receipt's dark panel runs into the 'Računovodski servis' heading, which is clipped at the first-screen edge; the services list is also shown twice.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Remove the hero's 'Pokličite nas / Pišite nam' text links (the fixed bar and header already call) and merge the receipt list with 'Naše storitve' so services appear once.","On desktop, balance the hero grid: give the receipt its own full-height panel and end the dark column before the 'Računovodski servis' heading instead of letting it hang below the fold.","Tighten vertical rhythm: cut the dead space under 'Davčno svetovanje' and after the 'Kako poteka' steps, and reduce the oversized '2004' so the about section reads as one block."],"blockers":["Desktop hero: the dark right column runs past the receipt and the 'Računovodski servis v Murski Soboti' heading is cut off at the first-screen edge, visually colliding with the panel.","Both viewports: the services list on the receipt and the 'Naše storitve' section repeat the same five items.","Both viewports: phone and e-mail appear in the contact section and again immediately below in the footer."]}
